settings.name: Stop duration
settings.description: The amount of time (in hours) to consider a tag stationary.

settings.name: Distance tolerance
settings.description: The amount of tolerance around GPS coordinates.

settings.name: Filter output to only show stationary tags
settings.description: Set to true to only include stationary tags (and exclude all non-stationary tags).

settings.name: Filter duration
settings.description: If filter output is set to true, how much time (in hours) of the stop trajectory to preserve.
